property_summary: For any caller and any uint value, calling SetMinSum(...) on an uninitialized contract should always succeed (reference: SetMinSum allowed only before Initialized()), whereas the mutant incorrectly only allows SetMinSum when already initialized, causing SetMinSum to revert for inputs where the contract is not initialized.
change_summary: Replace the conditional that prevents setting MinSum after initialization with its negation, allowing SetMinSum to only succeed when intitalized is true (so behavior differs after a call to SetMinSum).
